snippet.title: Akatori: Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Enjoy this new trailer for Akatori, the upcoming and very colorful pixel-art side-scrolling metroidvania where you, as Mako, use your staff to traverse and battle through different eras to stop the Amber Storms. It will be released for PC on August 5. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1442520/Akatori/

#IGN #Gaming
